relationships.subject: Noggin
relationships.evidence_quote: NOG alleviates SNL-induced NP by antagonizing the STAT3 signaling pathway, thereby rebalancing microglial polarization and restoring iron metabolism.

relationships.subject: Noggin
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared to SNL alone, the SNL+NOG group showed increased PWT, decreased CD11b, p-STAT3, and M1 marker expression (except TNF-α)

relationships.subject: BMP4
relationships.evidence_quote: BMP4 treatment increased CD11b, STAT3, p-STAT3, CD86, and hepcidin levels, while reducing CD204 and FPN

relationships.subject: Stattic
relationships.evidence_quote: Inhibition STAT3 with Stattic reversed these changes

key_findings: Intrathecal noggin reduced spinal p-STAT3, M1 microglial markers and hepcidin, restored ferroportin, and relieved SNL mechanical hypersensitivity in rats.
In primary microglia, BMP4 induced a STAT3-dependent pro-inflammatory, iron-accumulating phenotype that Stattic reversed.
